clv.note: CLV is the honest yardstick (better-number-than-close). Positive CLV = you locked a better price than the market settled at. No $ edge is claimed; this is calibrated decision-support only.

honest_note: Quant execution surface -- transparency only. Units/probability, never $. MOST validation verdicts are no_bet / match-the-close, which is a SUCCESS (markets are efficient), not a miss. gate_proven defaults False; CLV vs_close defaults UNPROVEN. Arb is descriptive (rare/fragile), never promoted. RoR is a model-conditional descriptive stat, NOT a profit or safety guarantee.
